checkpoints.optimizer_state_rule: The retained intermediate checkpoints contain model state only. Complete-successor dynamics and paired continuations therefore start at retained 24000-update states; no moments are imputed.

confirmation_statements.name: row_map_collapse_and_graph_control
confirmation_statements.rule: Report every seed, interval, and layer. A collapse cell has E_T/E_0 <= 1/3. Each validation seed must contain a collapse cell. Graph and covered-domain bounds must enclose measurements.

confirmation_statements.name: exact_route_reconstruction
confirmation_statements.rule: Gate plus shape log work, direct energy, fixed-Q gate work, shape flux, and zero cases replay within 1e-8 relative error.

confirmation_statements.name: gate_mechanism
confirmation_statements.rule: Decay plus loss memory reconstructs each gate step. The decay-off arm removes only direct gate decay; gate freeze removes gate work while retaining measurable shape work.

confirmation_statements.name: shape_mechanism
confirmation_statements.rule: Actual-update shape JVP plus measured remainder reconstructs the increment, transfers within factor 2, and the shape clamp removes shape work while retaining measurable gate work.

confirmation_statements.name: mixed_mechanism
confirmation_statements.rule: Route logs add exactly. A mechanism label requires material total log work of at least log(3) and a registered dominance fraction.

confirmation_statements.name: complete_successor_derivative
confirmation_statements.rule: The analytic 192 by 192 block matches float64 autodiff of the actual-minibatch successor at each retained-state anchor within relative residual 1e-8; every continuation block is freshly reconstructed before chronological composition.

confirmation_statements.name: coordinate_aware_robustness
confirmation_statements.rule: Report spectral radius, scaled induced norm, endpoint scaling condition number, gate block, moments, clipping, and dissipation.

confirmation_statements.name: plga_transfer
confirmation_statements.rule: Signed-power secants reconstruct every registered difference. A margin needs a nonempty held-out set, sqrt(2)B < Delta, a construction-owned constant, and factor-2 held-out transfer.

intervention_selection.fallback_rule: If no layer meets the primary rule, select the unique minimum-ratio layer with lower-index tie breaking.
intervention_selection.primary_rule: Select every layer whose minimum construction interval energy ratio is at most 1/3.
intervention_selection.validation_blinding: The selection consumes construction intervals only and is sealed before intervention observables are opened.

interventions.baseline_continue: Unmodified AdamW continuation for sixteen updates.
interventions.disable_final_gate_decay: Remove only decoupled weight decay from the selected gamma entries.
interventions.freeze_final_gate: Restore gamma and its first and second moments after every successor.
interventions.freeze_normalized_shape: Replay source normalized rows at the final LayerNorm interface and block their upstream gradient while retaining gate updates.
interventions.replay_physical_rows: Use the identical registered rows as a paired-data control.

ownership_rule: Seed 1234 and construction contexts own selections and bounds. Seeds 2222 and 3333 and disjoint contexts test them unchanged.

stages.evidence_rule: Deciding arrays are recomputed from digest-bound checkpoint tensors and registered contexts; log summaries are cross-checks.
